scope: OpenCode V2 runtime plugin + MCP capabilities inventory (Phase 2A, 2026-10-06). Declarations here never enable anything; status values require the cited evidence.
related: Complements source/registry/capabilities-v2.json (Fase 2A fatia 2 static curated registry: enforcement plugin id via repo-file probe, ai-memory via mcp-config probe). This file adds the machine-live plugin-autoload layer: V2 contract proof, V1-vs-V2 adapter split, active-root policy, and the AI-MEM-V1-20261006 incident evidence.
active_root_policy: The OpenCode V2 plugins directory (~/.config/opencode/plugins) is autodiscovered at server boot (plus watcher-triggered rescan on directory change, observed 2026-10-06). It must contain ONLY active, contract-compatible plugins. Forbidden in the active root: backups, V1-contract plugins, *.bak, *.disabled / *.v*-disabled, snapshots, rollback directories, old implementations — even when the current loader ignores a given suffix. Quarantine lives OUTSIDE the autodiscovered root (e.g. ~/.config/opencode/archive/).
runtime_contract_v2: Default export must be an object { id, effect | setup }. A bare-function default export (V1 contract) fails load with PluginModule.LoadError / SchemaError(Expected object at ["default"]). Proven by incident AI-MEM-V1-20261006.
regeneration_policy: Never regenerate with `ai-memory install-hooks --agent opencode` (emits the legacy V1 contract, incompatible with OpenCode >= 2.x). For V2 use ONLY `ai-memory install-hooks --agent opencode2 --apply`, and only when the current V2 file needs it. Upstream issue draft lives in the Phase 2A closure report appendix; do NOT open it without operator authorization.

ai-memory-mcp.note: Independent from plugin hooks. Healthy during incident AI-MEM-V1-20261006; the plugin LoadError was NOT an MCP/credential/network outage.
